body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Intuitive Surgical reports FY2026 worldwide da Vinci procedure growth of ≥14.5%. Evidence: 8-K 20-Oct-2026 (Q3 2026): da Vinci procedures +~14%, Ion +~31%; FY2026 outlook: procedure growth ~14–15%, 'The Company expects to be closer to the midpoint of this range'; non-GAAP GM 68.7–69.3% (incl. ~0.9 pt tariff hit); opex growth 11–13%. Reasoning: Management explicitly steers to ~14.5%; with Q3 at ~14% the outcome hinges on Q4 and on ISRG's rounding ('approximately 14%' would resolve NO). Slight lean below coin-flip because of the rounding convention. Resolution: YES if ISRG's reported FY2026 worldwide da Vinci procedure growth (Q4 2026 release or preliminary January announcement) is ≥14.5% as stated; 'approximately 14%' = NO, 'approximately 15%' or '14.5%' = YES. Source: Intuitive Surgical Q4 2026 / preliminary FY2026 release (SEC EDGAR, CIK 1035267). Resolve by 2027-01-31; score with Brier vs base rate.
